project.name: Protocol Mirror
project.summary: A human-agent clinical-trial transparency workspace where WebMCP agents assemble evidence and people retain final review authority.
project.ai_usage: Typed WebMCP tools let an agent retrieve bounded public records, inspect exact evidence, stage one structured mapping at a time, and request visible human review without gaining decision authority.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported research, product scoping, implementation, testing, security review, accessibility inspection, browser rehearsal, deployment verification, and submission preparation.
